_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Space Engineers egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Space Engineers
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The voxel sandbox of building ships and stations in space and on planets. Installs the Windows dedicated server with SteamCMD, runs it under Wine and keeps it updated.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Space Engineers. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 298740) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. The world and
# config, once made, are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-298740}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# A starting world and the server's config, made once: never replaced.
base=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/be654a201bf3b90446569167d4864edec1b33009/space_engineers/default
fetch() {
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$2.part" "$base/$1" || fail "The starting $1 can't be downloaded right now. Reinstall to try again."
    [ "$(sha256sum "$2.part" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$3" ] || { rm -f "$2.part"; fail "The starting $1 download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv "$2.part" "$2"
}
mkdir -p config/Saves
if [ ! -d config/Saves/World ]; then
    work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
    rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
    trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
    fetch World.zip "$work/World.zip" b2a982b36fd699dc2b220963b08ca35edce682ad581c914e94fffdb60b01b398
    unzip -q "$work/World.zip" -d config/Saves/
    echo "Made the starting world, config/Saves/World."
fi
if [ ! -f config/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg ]; then
    fetch SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg config/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg 723c5d1c71f845f6827f33fd70de1278ee02dddd112c9e59a4a0950db77efdda
fi
# The starting config came with a blank line before <?xml ...?>, which the
# server refuses (it then ignores the whole file and finds no world).
sed -i '/./,$!d' config/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg
# Steam's libraries next to the server, which Workshop mods need.
for f in steamclient.dll steamclient64.dll tier0_s.dll tier0_s64.dll vstdlib_s.dll vstdlib_s64.dll; do
    [ ! -f "$f" ] || cp -f "$f" DedicatedServer64/
done
echo "Installed Space Engineers build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: Survival or Creative.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Saving
variables.description: Save the world; false keeps nothing between restarts.

variables.name: Save interval
variables.description: How often the world is saved, in minutes.

variables.name: Experimental mode
variables.description: Turn on experimental features; most Workshop mods need it.

variables.name: In-game scripts
variables.description: Let players run programmable block scripts.

variables.name: Steam port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Remote API
variables.description: Turn on the game's remote admin API.

variables.name: Remote API port
variables.description: The remote admin API's port; give it an allocation if it's on.

variables.name: Wine packages
variables.description: What Wine installs before the server starts: the runtimes Space Engineers needs.

variables.name: Wine architecture
variables.description: Wine's architecture, 64-bit as the server is.

variables.name: Wine path
variables.description: Where Wine looks for programs.

variables.name: Windows install
variables.description: Install the Windows version of the server, which runs under Wine.

variables.name: Wine debug
variables.description: What Wine logs; -all keeps its messages out of the console.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
